actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.

actions.name: Poisonous Spittle
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga’s next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

actions.name: At Will
actions.text: Thaumaturgy 1/Day Each: Clairvoyance, Cure Wounds (level 6 ver- sion), Flame Strike (level 6 version), Geas, True Seeing Guards Guard Medium or Small Humanoid, Neutral AC 16 Initiative +1 (11) HP 11 (2d8 + 2) Speed 30 ft. actions.name: Spear
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. MOD SAVE MOD SAVE MOD SAVE Str 18 +4 +4 Dex 14 +2 +2 Con 16 +3 +3 Int 12 +1 +1 WIS 14 +2 +2 Cha 13 +1 +1 Skills Athletics +6, Perception +4 Gear Breastplate, Javelins (6), Longsword, Shield Senses Passive Perception 14 Languages Common CR 4 (XP 1,100; PB +2) Actions

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The guard makes two attacks, using Javelin or Longsword in any combination.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Celestial Restoration
traits.text: If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.
